₹5,000 ka loss hua. Toh aapne ₹20,000 ka trade le liya, wapas jeetne ke liye. Ruko!
Ise kehte hain revenge trading, aur yeh accounts kha jaata hai.
Loss ke baad, dimaag chahta hai ki dard abhi ke abhi khatam ho.
Toh aap bada trade lete ho, jaldi mein, aur bina plan ke.
Account ka 10% gaya, toh wapas aane ke liye 11% chahiye.
Aadha gaya, toh break even ke liye 100% chahiye.
Loss ke baad bade trade, yeh gaddha aur gehra karte hain, aur jaldi.
Toh market khulne se pehle ek rule set karo: din ka maximum loss.
Woh hit hua, toh app band karo, aur uth jaao.
Market kal bhi rahega. Bas dhyaan rakho, aapka paisa bhi rahe.
